searchText: not at all, 1559 does not set a maximum gas limit proposers could coordinate to raise the gas limit to say 100M or even more gas theoretically all 1559 does is apply congestion pricing as a function of block size with some "slack" space allocated to handle temporary fluctuations away from some long-run target the target can float up or down just like pre-1559 the gas limit could float up or down Am retardo thx for clarification We've got the Ropsten relay+builder ready 🚀 https://builder-relay-ropsten.flashbots.net - it will produce blocks after the merge.
